excluded_or_superseded_trials.harness_errors: Initial A/P0 array typing errors and pipeline fixture parse/route-length errors were repaired before successful formal runs. They are not evidence of product failures or accepted measurements.

limitations: Phase timers are inclusive wall-clock CPU intervals; child install/present timers cannot be added to process totals.
Whole-pipeline A/B uses actual codecs and process calls over serialized in-memory transport with a deterministic clock, not a public-network FPS test.

Codec.digest normalizes numbers to eight decimal places. Matching pipeline hashes do not prove bitwise equality of all floats; B also directly compares captured state and D directly compares movement results.
Native MultiMesh resource readback is not pixel validation or a GPU completion fence.
CLI --max-fps 24 is overridden by Settings. Native A measured Engine.max_fps=120 and VSync=1; historic motion real FPS cannot be inferred.
No new native DTLS transport run, exported client binary, or remote Relay deployment in this task.
Nonzero offsets still follow terrain projection; saturated scenes retain CPU bottlenecks. Stable 60 FPS is not established.
